notes:
Inbound from sales enablement / call-summary space. They capture rep/customer calls via integrated recorder (Fireflies) and want to push transcripts + structured summaries into CRM. Main pain: PII handling and retention.

Key fragments from call:
- CEO: "We can't have credit cards or SSNs sitting in a logs bucket — need auto-redact and short retention."
- CTO: wants a simple hosted flow for SMB but needs written guarantees about retention and an admin toggle to disable storing transcripts.
- SE: curious about redaction hooks at ingest vs post-processing; asked if Redwood provides client-side redaction SDK or server-side filters.

They are preference for Hosted API (self-serve) to move fast; cost sensitive (early-stage pricing). Primary ask: POC with sample recordings where Redwood demonstrates redaction + configurable retention (7/30/90 days) and confirmation that PII fields (SSN, CC, emails) can be stripped or replaced. Also asked for sample logs showing what is retained.

Tone: pragmatic, fast-moving SMB. No enterprise contract yet; legal will review security FAQ before any purchase.
